Name: (FS) Shardust's Hairstyes -Direct port of my Content Patcher hair mod-
Author: Shardust
Description:
[size=4][i][b][size=5][center][size=4][i][b][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/geHwxPE.png[/img]
This is a [u]direct port[/u] of my [u]Content Patcher[/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8138]hairstyles mod[/url]﻿.
These hair are [u]NOT[/u] animated!

[size=4][i][b][size=5][size=4][i][b][size=5]November 2025 update[/size]
Current Total: 104.
[/b][/i][/size][/size][/b][/i][/size]Folders have been renamed.
[u]Remove the old version or you'll get duplicates![/u]
[/size][/b][/i][/size][size=3][u][b]
Tested with the latest game update, the latest SMAPI update and the latest Fashion Sense update.[/b][/u]
These hair are available through the [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿[/u] framework.
[/size][size=4]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/zAKbvXC.png[/img]
[size=3]Also available an optional file in a lighter grey making it easier to have pastel/neon colors ingame![b][u]
[/u][/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kfx1Va7.png[/img]
[size=4][i][b][size=5][size=3]Also available an optional file with Prismatic Colors![/size][/size][/b][/i][/size]

[size=4]While I want to add more styles, I need time to practice and improve my
pixelwork, so it'll probably take months between updates.

I do hope you'll enjoy what's available!

[i][b]I have another mod for Fashion Sense with [/b][/i][u][i][b]animated[/b][/i][/u][i][b] [/b][/i][i][b]hairstyles! [/b][/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10294]Check it out!
[/url][/i][/size]
[size=2][i][b][size=3][u]All my mods will always be freely available[/u], but if you enjoyed them and wish to fuel my pizza cravings (I'm Italian, I [u]always[/u] want pizza)
[url=https://ko-fi.com/ladyshardust]I have a KO-FI[/url][/size][/b][/i][/size][/center][/size][/b][/i][/size]

Downloads.Description:
November 2025 update. 104 Hairstyles.
This is a -direct- FS port of my Content Patcher mod which -only features custom hairstyles-, so the hair is -not- animated.
Folders have been renamed.
FULLY REMOVE THE OLD VERSION OR YOU'LL GET DUPLICATES!
